name.zh: 字符鲨鱼追踪价格路径

description.en: An ASCII hammerhead swims along three forecast price paths and tags each with its odds, volatility and dealer gamma; the pointer steers it to the nearest path, or lets it swim freely over the candle history.
description.zh: 字符锤头鲨沿三条预测价格路径游动，依次标记概率、波动率与 dealer gamma；指针在预测区时鲨鱼追向最近的路径，移到左侧K线区时鲨鱼跟着指针自由游动。

keywords: 鲨鱼 锤头鲨 字符 ASCII 价格 路径 预测 K线 概率 金融 图表 终端 hammerhead shark price paths forecast candles chart terminal

discovery.caveat: 价格路径是界面演示，使用前确认数据来源与业务含义。

source.license: Retain source notices and design-reference attribution; no blanket license is assigned by the catalog.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Watch the shark tag each path in turn. Move the pointer over the forecast cone, hover or click a label, or use the arrow keys to choose a path. Prices are local demonstration data.
instructions.zh: 鲨鱼会依次标记每条路径。在预测锥区移动指针，悬停或点击右侧标签，或用方向键选择路径。价格为本地演示数据。
